difficulty_reason: Given a, b : K -> L morphisms of hypercoverings, set K' = K x_{L x L} Hom(Delta[1], L); by functoriality of Hom(Delta[1], -) the two horizontal maps correspond to a morphism K' x Delta[1] -> L, i.e. a homotopy between a c and b c; verify K' is a hypercovering by lemma-funny-gamma applied to K -> L x L and Hom(Delta[1],L) -> L x L: condition (1) holds since K is a hypercovering, condition (2) since Hom(Delta[1],L)_0 = L_1 and (d_0,d_1) : L_1 -> L_0 x L_0 is a covering of SR(C,X) by the hypercovering property of L, condition (3) via lemma-hom-hypercovering, which identifies the gamma-arrow with Hom(Delta[1] x Delta[n+1], L)_0 -> Hom(U, L)_0, a covering by lemma-add-simplices.
